notes: RuneDef: admin-only, no Public flag (spawn/script controlled).
UI hints included (labels/tooltips) where confirmed from editor screenshots; remaining entries are placeholders for future capture.
DiceConfig: Fully documented - controls node count, point allocation, buff/debuff limits, point buy systems.
DiceRules, Gear tables added as WIP - not yet exposed in UI.

tooltips.TotalNodes: Total number of nodes in the system, including deleted ones
tooltips.AttributePoints: Allocated attribute points players are allowed (character sheet tracked)
tooltips.SkillPoints: Skill points allowed for distribution (character sheet tracked)
tooltips.MaxSkillAllocation: Maximum skill point allocation per skill
tooltips.PerkPoints: Perk points (character sheet tracked, used to purchase perks that cost points)
tooltips.AttributePointBuy: Enable point buy for attributes. Cost increases: 0->1=1pt, 1->2=1pt, 2->3=2pts, 3->4=3pts, etc.
tooltips.SkillPointBuy: Enable point buy for skills. Same escalating cost logic as attribute point buy.
tooltips.MaxPlayersPerAbility: Maximum number of players that can be selected/targeted by an ability

tooltips.Number of Dice: Number of dice rolled on a check (1-n)
tooltips.Sides of Dice: Number of sides on each die (2-n)
tooltips.Critical Failure Threshold: Roll <= this value triggers critical failure
tooltips.Critical Success Threshold: Roll >= this value triggers critical success
tooltips.Roll vs Meet to Beat: On contested rolls, determines how ties are resolved
tooltips.Enable D8D 5e Advantage Modifiers: Enables advantage/disadvantage modifiers on the character sheet

tooltips.UseArmorAppearance: If enabled, transmogged items will use their visual item to detect armor weight instead of actual equipped item. Only compatible with RR's transmog system (not Fashionist or Outfit Manager).
tooltips.ScanHead: Include head slot when scanning armor weight
tooltips.ScanTorso: Include torso slot when scanning armor weight
tooltips.ScanHands: Include hands slot when scanning armor weight
tooltips.ScanLegs: Include legs slot when scanning armor weight
tooltips.ScanFeet: Include feet slot when scanning armor weight
tooltips.ArmorWeightFunction: How to calculate final armor weight: Highest (Light+Heavy=Heavy), Lowest (Light+Heavy=Light), Average Down (Med+Heavy=Med), Average Up (Med+Heavy=Heavy)

tooltips.Public: t = selectable by players; f = hidden/admin

tooltips.Function: Effect to apply (select from list; mapping can be adjusted in schema)

tooltips.Scale: Final Multiplier: multiplies the combined contributor result
tooltips.BonusFunction: How bonus sources are combined: Sum adds all, Average takes the mean, Take Min/Max uses extreme values

labels.Auto Equip on Add: Auto Equip when added to inventory
labels.Auto Equip on Equip: Auto Equip when equipped by character.

tooltips.Game Item ID: Enter a verified Conan Exiles item ID or use None when no backing item exists yet.

tooltips.Effect: Effect code (col 4): 0=Dice Modifier, 1=Grant Perk, 3=Stat Modifier, 4=Grant Ability, 5=Grant Status, 6=Unlock Status
tooltips.TargetID: Chosen type to be affected (col 2): Attribute/Skill for Dice, Stat for Stat Modifier, Perk/Ability/Status for grants
tooltips.Value: Value (col 3): numeric 'by' amount for Dice and Stat Modifier; ignored for grant/unlock

tooltips.Condition: Select a condition type. Certain types will show custom inputs (e.g., Climate, Shelter).
tooltips.NodeAffected: Node the condition checks (e.g., Skill ID for Skill Allocation, Stat ID for Stat conditions).
tooltips.Value: Numeric value for the condition check.
tooltips.MaxValue: Max value when using Between or Outside operators.
tooltips.Category: Buff category name (only used with Buff Category condition).

tooltips.Function: 0=Modify Skill, 1=Modify Stat, 2=Grant Perk, 3=Grant Ability, 4=Grant Status, 5=Unlock Status

tooltips.DCTypeFormula: Reference to a shared DC formula (ID or name).
tooltips.TargetDCFormula: Optional dice/expression to override the Target DC (e.g., 1d20+3). Leave blank to use default.

tooltips.Operator: ==/!= for categorical requirements; Between/Outside enables Value/Max ranges
tooltips.ValueMin: Numeric threshold; use Max to supply the upper bound when needed.
tooltips.Text: Optional text label (used when Function is Status Category).

tooltips.Function: Select a condition type. Certain types will show custom inputs (e.g., Climate, Shelter).
tooltips.Param: Condition node or parameter reference used by the selected function.
tooltips.ValueMin: Numeric value or enum code depending on condition.
tooltips.Text: Optional category text; leave blank when unused (cell is still exported).
